summary: Cleared an accepted composer message before awaiting native generation; restore occurs only after a typed blocker or IPC error.
Proved with the real local SmolLM2 GGUF that reacquiring an unchanged model profile returns the same resident owner-thread worker and leaves one resident slot.
Re-proved exact Persona prefix reuse: the first mention creates the versioned cache, the next mention reuses it, and a Persona edit invalidates it.
Made message actions latent and icon-only at rest; they appear on message hover or keyboard focus.
Removed the Persona-template banner and internal template-selection route from the conversation surface.
Made Persona names in both the primary picker and Settings start an ordinary sourced chat; profile editing remains behind the Settings pencil.
Filtered selected PersonaTemplate records out of the chat projection so a stale internal selection falls back to a real chat.

Rebuilt and launched the macOS bundle. The user confirmed the composer correction and improved responsiveness; final visual confirmation of the new latent actions and normal Persona start remains human-review evidence.

tests_run.detail: One real owner-thread worker was loaded; repeated unchanged profile acquisition returned the same Arc allocation and the registry contained one slot.
The exact Persona version reused its native prefix state and the edited Persona version fell back to ordinary generation.
All deterministic runtime, engine, cache, command-evidence, CLI, and readiness tests passed; real-environment cases remained ignored by default.

Inference remains in-process; 81 commands, 90 affordances, 25 effects, 36 parity rows, 58 settings, zero blockers.
